g.text: Connector pinout follows DroneCAN / Pixhawk JST-GH: 1 = +5 V, 2 = CANH, 3 = CANL, 4 = GND.

g.desc: Connector pinout follows DroneCAN / Pixhawk JST-GH: 1 = +5 V, 2 = CANH, 3 = CANL, 4 = GND.

g.text: Bus supply must be 5 V nominal (LM66100 ORing on the Power sheet is rated 5.5 V max).
